facts.fact: The 2026 finance law appropriates FCFA 33,000,000,000 for programme 23237 Appui au Développement des nouvelles technologies en zones rurales of the Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalisation (section 356), own-source funding.

Programme 23237 is a compte d'affectation spécial funded by an earmarked levy on telecom operators; the 2026 finance law appropriates FCFA 33,000,000,000 to rural technology support. The FY2025 programme was titled as a tax for digital development; the enabling law is not named.

note: The page does not state whether the funding mechanism changed with the 2026 renaming; no rose or fell fact as FY2025 amount is not given.
